frequency_question: How often do announced major industrial incentive frameworks successfully reach formal final gazette notification and implementation within 3 years of initial visible precursor signals?
membership_rule: Includes major national transport or industrial manufacturing financial support schemes that reached initial policy drafting stage; excludes minor budgetary line-item modifications or state-level schemes.

cases.name: Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Hybrid and Electric Vehicles (FAME I) India
Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Components India
National Electric Mobility Mission Plan (NEMMP) India
US Zero-Emission Truck and Bus Deployment Strategy Framework
EU Alternative Fuels Infrastructure Regulation (AFIR) Implementation Framework
National Hydrogen Mission Financial Outlay Scheme India

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 7 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 7 named; representative of major national frameworks globally over the last two decades
known_gaps: Some smaller regional or delayed draft programs that remained stalled are excluded by membership rule defining 'major national frameworks'.
skeleton: named cases representing major national heavy vehicle/EV industrial schemes
multiplier: 7 hits out of 7 visible precursor cases in major jurisdictions
validity_reason: Policy institutional mechanics and bureaucratic speeds for major industrial subsidies remain stable across medium-term electoral cycles.
